description: Tool to delete an invoice item from Stripe. Use when removing invoice items that are not attached to invoices or attached to draft invoices.

inputSchema.description: Request model for deleting an invoice item.

invoiceitem.description: The identifier of the invoice item to be deleted. Deleting invoice items is only possible when they're not attached to invoices, or if it's attached to a draft invoice.
invoiceitem.title: Invoiceitem

inputSchema.title: DeleteInvoiceitemRequest

name: delete_invoiceitem

DeleteInvoiceitemResponse.description: Response model for a deleted invoice item.

deleted.description: Always true for a successful deletion.
deleted.title: Deleted

id.description: Unique identifier for the deleted invoice item.
id.title: Id

object.description: String representing the object's type. Always 'invoiceitem' for this endpoint.
object.title: Object

DeleteInvoiceitemResponse.title: DeleteInvoiceitemResponse
